water.name: Land
water.rule: At least 4 of the hex's 7 sample points (centre + 6) fall on SIANE municipality or Natural Earth country outlines, unless the centre is sea and the ETOPO1 mean is at or below sea level, or at least half its ETOPO1 samples are (rías and estuaries stay water).

water.name: Ocean
water.rule: Sea deeper than 200 m and not next to land.

water.name: Coast
water.rule: Sea next to a land hex, or shallower than 200 m (ETOPO1 mean).

water.name: Lake
water.rule: Water hex (most of its 7 sample points off land) with Natural Earth 1:50m lake points that outnumber sea points, or above sea level.

relief.name: Flat
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation inside the hex under 32 m.

relief.name: Mountains
relief.rule: Elevation standard deviation ≥ 138 m, or mean elevation ≥ 2,300 m.

cover.name: None
cover.rule: Water, foreign land, or no CORINE land pixels.

cover.name: Deciduous forest
cover.rule: Forest (41+42+43) is the largest group and deciduous (41) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Conifer forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and evergreen (42) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Mixed forest
cover.rule: Forest is the largest group and mixed (43) the largest forest type.

cover.name: Scrub & desert
cover.rule: Shrub/scrub (52) is the largest group: deserts, chaparral, sagebrush.

cover.name: Grassland
cover.rule: Grassland/herbaceous (71) plus developed open space (21: lawns, parks) is the largest group.

cover.name: Cropland
cover.rule: Cultivated crops (82) is the largest group.

cover.name: Wetland
cover.rule: Woody (90) plus emergent herbaceous (95) wetlands is the largest group.

cover.name: Urban
cover.rule: Developed low/medium/high intensity (22+23+24) is ≥ 30% of the hex's land, whatever else is there.

cover.name: Barren
cover.rule: Barren land (31: rock, sand, playa) is the largest group.

cover.name: Ice & snow
cover.rule: Perennial ice/snow (12) is the largest group.

notes.water: SIANE 1:3M municipality outlines and Natural Earth 1:10m country and lake outlines don't meet exactly. A sea hex whose ETOPO1 mean is above sea level (and under half of its samples below it) becomes land when at least 4 of its 6 neighbours are land, or when it touches both Spanish and foreign land; it takes the neighbours' majority owner. A sea hex's elevation is the mean of its ETOPO1 samples below sea level (its water depth). The Canary Islands are drawn in an inset box south-west of the peninsula; their hexes keep their real elevation and land cover.
notes.relief: From ETOPO1 samples (1 arc-minute, ~1.85 km apart, about 25 per 10 km hex) with altitude ≥ -100 m, so bays and sea floor don't count; all samples are used if none qualify. Water hexes are always flat. The roughness thresholds are lower than the US map's (85 m and 260 m on 25 km hexes) because a smaller hex spans less relief: they were set so Spain gets the same shares of flat, hilly and mountainous land as under the US rule on 25 km hexes.
notes.cover: From CORINE Land Cover 2018 (Copernicus), sampled on a lattice inside each Spanish hex. CORINE classes are cross-walked to the NLCD-style groups below (the crosswalk is in the Almanac entry for CORINE); water (5xx) and no-data pixels are ignored, shares are of the remaining land points, and the urban threshold is applied to the rounded built-up share (CORINE 111, 112, 121–124, 131–133). Foreign hexes (Portugal, France, Andorra, Morocco) have cover 0 (none).
